ENS NPM Account Compromise (Shai Hulud V2)

Target: ensdomains-npm
Repository: https://github.com/ensdomains/ens-contracts
Date: 2025-11-24
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft/Self-Propagation
User Impact: 0
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The Shai Hulud self-propagating worm compromised the Ethereum Name Service (ENS) NPM account, injecting malware into critical dependencies like @ensdomains/ens-validation and ethereum-ens. Upon installation, the worm uses TruffleHog to steal credentials and automatically spreads by compromising other NPM accounts.
